mapper.update: UPDATE todos SET title = #{title}, detail = #{detail}, category = #{category}, priority = #{priority}, due_date = #{dueDate}, completed = #{completed} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO todos (title, detail, category, priority, due_date, completed) VALUES (#{title}, #{detail}, #{category}, #{priority}, #{dueDate}, COALESCE(#{completed}, FALSE))
mapper.select: SELECT category AS label, COUNT(*) AS count FROM todos GROUP BY category ORDER BY category
SELECT priority AS label, COUNT(*) AS count FROM todos GROUP BY priority ORDER BY priority
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM todos WHERE completed = TRUE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM todos WHERE completed = FALSE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM todos WHERE completed = FALSE AND due_date IS NOT NULL AND due_date < #{today}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS label, COUNT(*) AS count FROM todos WHERE completed = TRUE AND updated_at >= #{from} AND updated_at < DATE_ADD(#{to}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY label
SELECT CASE WHEN completed = TRUE THEN '完了' ELSE '未完了' END AS label, COUNT(*) AS count FROM todos GROUP BY completed ORDER BY completed DESC
